name: Sika® Wonder Wipes
tagline: MULTI-USE CLEANING WIPES FOR THE BUILDING TRADE
summary: Sika® Wonder Wipes are specially formulated to clean hands, tools and surfaces from wet and semi-cured paint, sealant, adhesive, bitumen, expanding foam, oil, grease and even silicone. Particularly useful when there is no water on site.
metaDescription: Sika® Wonder Wipes are specially formulated to clean hands, tools and surfaces from wet and semi-cured paint, sealant, adhesive, bitumen, expanding foam, oil, grease and even silicone. Particularly useful when there is no water on site.
attributes: Formulated to remove the toughest of grime.
Contains aloe vera to condition skin and prevent dryness and cracking.
usage: Cleaning wet and semi-cured paints, sealants, adhesives, bitumen, polyurethanes, expanding foams, polyester fillers and epoxies from hands, tools and surfaces.
advantages: Formulated to remove the toughest of grime.
Contains aloe vera to condition skin and prevent dryness and cracking.

items.label: CERTIFICATES AND TEST REPORTS
items.text: Sika® Wonder Wipes and Sika® Wonder Wipes Biodegradable contain an anti-bacterial additive tested by an independent laboratory to EN 1276 chemical disinfectants and antiseptics.

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: Sika® Wonder Wipes must be used within 36 months from the date of manufacture and within 6 months from opening.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Store in cool dry conditions away from direct sunlight between +5 °C and +25 °C. Storage outside these parameters will significantly reduce shelf life.
